address: 10F, MARUNOUCHI TERRACE, 1-3-4 Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, 100-0005, Japan
bio: A brasserie on the top floor of a tall building in the heart of Tokyo. Views from the spacious rooftop terrace are breathtaking. The buzz of guests’ conversation and the affable service is a joyous reflection of the bustling city below. Regional French favourites include salade Lyonnaise, bouillabaisse and duck confit. Experience everyday French dining in a contemporary ambience....
